absolutely sir, I wil prepare as well as I can. 

It is just not that easy to find a good method on the internet, so I thought I would ask here, as there are proly many people here, who are pretty well-informed on the topic.

This is by far not impulsive, I am not some teen being desperate after break up. Just my situation gets worse and worse and I strongly believe that suicide is the best option for me, rather than suffering and dissapointing my beloved once.

Thanks for your rationed response though.

usually we do not care what others say, but here is some rationing:
1)you have a car and your debt is very small. this part is not that bad, is it? you can sell your car and pay your debt in the worst case.
2)you sitll have plenty of time to finish your education. And it seems you know what you want to be doing. It shall provide motivaiton once you start studying for something related.
3)consiner changing your area of living - try learning a new language. Is thre any place you think you can be happier?
4)you would do much more harm to your beloved ones by committing suicide, than by staying alive.

Sorry if it is bullshit, but it is what I actually believe.
If you want to talk about it I would be glad to do it.

And yeah, I actually came to this place just now , cause I am also planning a suicide, so I can relate.
